messages:
Maya (CS): FYI loop 11 Sam from Halcyon AP says they can't process the renewal until we provide a one-page signoff that lists the exact billing entity + invoice split. Their PO will be two-line (US entity + EMEA subsidiary). DocuSign envelope currently shows only Halcyon Group so PO won't match.
Noah (AM): Oof. Do they need two separate signatures or just one stub referencing both entities?
Sam (Customer Finance): One stub is fine but it must state: 1) Halcyon US (EIN: 12-3456789) invoice for $80,000; 2) Halcyon EMEA Ltd (VAT: GB987654321) invoice for a330,000. Also vendor code HAL-77.
Rina (Ops): Can you share the envelope ID so we can check billing metadata? If it's a metadata mismatch we can remap, otherwise we'll create a stub PDF for AP.
Maya (CS): envelope: 9f3b8c2a-11b4-4c9e-b2d2. Also Sam prefers a PDF emailed to ap@halcyon.co rather than a DocuSign link.
DocuSign Bot: Alert 1 1 envelope 9f3b8c2a flagged: billing_entity == "Halcyon Group" (no subsidiary).
Daniel (Legal): Quick notes for the stub: add clause "This one-page signoff is for procurement routing only and is not an amendment to the Master Agreement." Add signer name/title/email and line for PO number. Keep language minimal.
Noah (AM): Is wet-sign acceptable if they physically need to attach a scanned copy?
Daniel (Legal): For net value <$200k we can accept scanned wet signatures if Ops uploads to Box and we store audit metadata. This renewal total is 130k total so wet-scan ok.
Rina (Ops): I can produce a two-line stub PDF and send both DocSend and direct PDF. Will leave blank fields for signer name/title/PO. Also will include vendor code HAL-77 and AP contact.
Sam (Customer Finance): Direct PDF emailed to ap@halcyon.co is preferred. Also include a verification contact (finance@redwood.com).
Maya (CS): I'll send them three options in one email: (A) corrected DocuSign envelope with subsidiary metadata (fastest if we can fix now), (B) one-page PDF stub they attach to their PO, (C) wet-signed scan. Which would you use?
Sam (Customer Finance): Option B. Please email PDF and cc our AP mailbox.
Rina (Ops): Drafting now. Linking internal audit note: Box path /Redwood/Approvals/halcyon/renewals/6061234567-stub.pdf
Noah (AM): Thanks Rina. I'm booking a 3pm call with Sam in case they push for the primary envelope fix.
Daniel (Legal): Rina, please add the legal clause and a short signature block. Also include a line: "Referenced Order Form dated 2026-01-28."
Rina (Ops): Done. PDF generated and emailing now. DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/redwood-halcyon-stub-6061234567 (view-only). Email sent to ap@halcyon.co, cc finance@redwood.com.
Sam (Customer Finance): Got it. Passing to AP for attachment to PO. Will update when PO issued.
Maya (CS): Added ticket OPS-7921 to update envelope billing mapping so future renewals land with correct subsidiary.
Rina (Ops): OPS-7921 created. Assigned to billing-ops. ETA 3 business days.
DocuSign Bot: Notice 1 envelope 9f3b8c2a metadata update recommended.
Sam (Customer Finance): One more ask 1 our procurement wants the invoice schedule line itemized: "US invoice due on execution, EMEA invoice due net30 from invoice date." Can you add that phrasing?
Maya (CS): I'll add that sentence to the stub and resend.
Rina (Ops): Updated PDF sent. Box path updated and audit note appended.
Noah (AM): Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. If PO stalls I'll escalate to Billing Ops and Legal execs.
Sam (Customer Finance): AP confirms PO routed. Will share PO number when it clears. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Closing thread pending PO number. If anything breaks, reopen and escalate.
